question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Appalled
solution:
The correct answer is: **Disgusted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Appalled"** means to be greatly dismayed or horrified. (भयभीत)

 
 
• **Example: **She was appalled by the state of the hospital.
 
 
 
• **"Disgusted"** refers to a strong feeling of dislike or disapproval. (घृणा महसूस करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He was disgusted by the unfair treatment of the workers.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Appalled'** is **'Disgusted'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Disgusted**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Allied** (सहयोगी): United or working together.

 
 
• **Example:** The two countries were allied during the war.
 
 
 
• **Clap** (ताली): Strike the palms of the hands together with a sudden explosive sound.
 
 
• **Example:** The audience began to clap after the performance.
 
 
 
• **Applied** (लागू): Put to practical use.
 
 
• **Example:** She applied for a job at the new company.
